description: Stress and morale (design doc §14.3; M4 spec claim 8): per-agent stress in milli-units 0..1 000 000, raised by being fired at (a shot at the agent, or one whose line passes within near_miss_mm), by being hit and by a squadmate going down; decayed per tick. hit_penalty_at_max is the hit_chance penalty (basis points of a percent) at full stress, linear below. Above break_threshold the agent prefers to retreat; above rout_threshold it may only retreat or surrender.
